messages.content:
Several readers answered the same question about machines at work, each pointing at the sentences it used. Decide which answer the evidence supports. Use only the evidence shown; do not use what you know.

Rules:
- An answer is supported only if its evidence states it for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the
  same article and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline, the same condition the question
  states). Evidence about a neighbouring subject does not support an answer.
- When the two rest on texts of different rank, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's
  manual, then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.)
  wins over a ministerial decree (DM). A wording corrected by a corrigendum replaces the original wording.
- For a list, prefer the answer whose items are each stated by the evidence and that leaves none out.
- Readers that found nothing are listed too: when most readers found nothing and the one answer shown rests on evidence about a neighbouring subject, choose "none".
Return JSON only: {"reasoning": "two or three short sentences", "choice": <the number of the answer supported, or "none">}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Which models in the catalogue, self-certified today with internal checks, will need a notified body from 20 January 2027?

Answer 1 (given by 1 reader(s): search): ["MA STAR 3.5 A STOCK", "MA STAR 3.5 S STOCK", "MA STAR 3.5 A", "MA STAR 3.5 S", "MA STAR 3.5 A BMW", "MA STAR 3.5 A MB", "VAS 771 043 (MA STAR 3.5 A)", "MA STAR 5.5 STOCK", "MA STAR 5.5", "MA STAR 5.5 MB", "VAS 771 045 (MA STAR 5.5)", "MA STAR 6.5 STOCK", "MA STAR 6.5", "MA STAR 6.5 MB"]
All 14 two-post lift models in the MAHA declaration of conformity (mastar-manual, section 10) are vehicle servicing lifts. Under Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 Annex I, Part A, point 3, and Article 25(2), they need a notified body from 20 January 2027 (Article 54). Units placed on the market under Directive 2006/42/EC before that date remain saleable under Article 52(1).
Evidence:
- Found by search: mastar-manual, p. 37 | sentence: "Typ | Model Serialnummer | Serial Number MA STAR 3.5 A STOCK ......................... VP 251230" [mastar-manual, p. 37]
- Found by search: mastar-manual, p. 37 | sentence: "Richtlinien | Directives 2006/42/EG 2006/42/EC 2014/53/EU 2014/53/EU" [mastar-manual, p. 37]
- Found by search: REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3 | sentence: "3. Vehicle servicing lifts." [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 25(2) | sentence: "Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 2. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X." [REG, Art. 25(2)]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 54 (corrected by the corrigendum (Corrigendum, point 10: '14 January 2027' now reads '20 January 2027'; Corrigendum, point 11: '14 January 2024' now reads '20 January 2024'; Corrigendum, point 12: '14 October 2023' now reads '20 October 2026'; Corrigendum, point 13: '13 July 2023' now reads '19 July 2023'; Corrigendum, point 14: '14 July 2024' now reads '20 July 2024')) | sentence: "Article 54 Entry into force and application This Regulation shall enter into force on the twentieth day following that of its publication in the Official Journal of the European Union . It shall apply from 20 January 2027." [REG, Art. 54]
- Found by search: REG, Art. 52(1) (corrected by the corrigendum (Corrigendum, point 6: '14 January 2027' now reads '20 January 2027'; Corrigendum, point 7: '13 July 2023' now reads '19 July 2023')) | sentence: "Article 52 Transitional provisions. 1. Member States shall not impede the making available on the market of products which were placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027." [REG, Art. 52(1)]

Readers that found nothing: facts, words, similar

response.text:
The evidence names only one model, "MA STAR 3.5 A STOCK", from the declaration of conformity. The other 13 items in the list are not stated in any sentence shown. Nothing shown says these models are vehicle servicing lifts, or that they are self-certified with internal checks today. The regulation sentences cover the category in general but not these models. Most readers found nothing, so I choose "none".

{"reasoning": "Only one of the 14 listed models appears in the evidence, and nothing shown says the MA STAR units are vehicle servicing lifts or that they are self-certified today. The regulation sentences cover the lift category generally, not these models. Most readers found nothing, so the answer is not supported.", "choice": "none"}
